scope: Fixed current product C# under src and language standard library under stdlib, excluding build bin/obj, vendor, tests, docs, caches and tools. The checked-in Unicode generated data is counted but fixed: deleting or relocating it gives no reduction credit. Net new product code in any destination is added to the final count; moving code does not qualify.
counting: cloc code lines excludes comments/blanks; also retain physical lines and content hashes. Minification, hiding code in strings/generated files, moving to excluded paths, changing extension, removing features/tests do not count.
semantic_requirement: All established source/HIR/portable/bound/REPL/editor/IO and resource/alias/lifetime contracts remain; correctness and reduction are joint acceptance conditions.
